items.title: Robinhood’s Crypto Slump Got the Headlines. Its 10x Business Got Ignored.
items.summary: Robinhood Markets, Inc. (NASDAQ:HOOD) reported record quarterly revenue on July 29, 2026, and the stock faded anyway.
